title: Recovery after a suspected scam
summary: A short route for containing an account or payment after suspicious contact.
scenario: You may have clicked, paid, shared information, or granted access and need to reduce further harm.
warning_signs: A payment or credential was disclosed
A device or session may be controlled by someone else
safe_actions: Stop contact and use a known-safe device or route
Secure the most affected account first
Ask a trusted person to help preserve evidence
recovery_guidance: Contact providers promptly and ask what containment is available
Change credentials and review sessions through known routes
reporting_guidance: Use an official destination only after checking it independently
Do not send passwords or recovery phrases in a report
prevention_tips: Prepare a list of known provider contacts
Turn on account alerts where available
false_positive_notes: An alert may be harmless, but containment and independent verification are low-risk first steps.
